card.name: Old dictionary and historical prose
card.fires_on: Scattered tokens in old public-domain texts: dictionary entry markers such as a part-of-speech 'v' or an opening parenthesis, and linking words like 'of', 'had', 'having' in 19th-century historical or scientific prose.

modes.label: Dictionary entry markers
modes.description: Pronunciation brackets or part-of-speech letters in old dictionary entries.
modes.example: GNU Webster's 1913 -<< v>>. To cry as cats in rutting

modes.label: Linking words in old prose
modes.description: Small verbs and prepositions such as 'had', 'having', 'of' in 19th-century historical or Darwin-style text.
modes.example: with the principle of new species having been formed by dominant species spreading widely and varying; the new species thus produced being themselves dominant, owing to their having<< had>> some advantage over their already dominant parents,
